ExampleRefusalCodeV1.description: 📚️ The frozen fault codes of a refused example switch (`setActiveExample`): the id names no example the surface declares (`example.unknown`), the declared example's authored asset does not decode into the artifact's document (`example.undecodable`), or it decodes into the genesis document (`example.empty`). Rust `ExampleRefusalKind::code`, TypeScript `EXAMPLE_REFUSAL_CODES_V1`.

ExampleRefusalMessagesV1.description: 🗣️ The notice a shell shows for each example refusal, in English and German — Rust `ExampleRefusalKind::label`, TypeScript `EXAMPLE_REFUSAL_MESSAGES_V1`.

example.unknown.en: This app has no example with that name.
example.unknown.de: Diese App hat kein Beispiel mit diesem Namen.

example.undecodable.en: The example could not be read: its file is outdated or damaged.
example.undecodable.de: Das Beispiel konnte nicht gelesen werden: Seine Datei ist veraltet oder beschädigt.

example.empty.en: The example file is empty, so nothing was loaded.
example.empty.de: Die Beispieldatei ist leer, daher wurde nichts geladen.

ExampleRefusalV1.description: 🙅️ One refused example switch as it crosses a boundary: the frozen code, the example id the switch named, and the decoder's own detail (empty for `example.unknown` and `example.empty`). It travels as a `Fault` whose `code` is `code`, severity `warning`, never retryable, with `detail` as its one cause.

ExampleRefusalFixture.description: 📚️ THE example-seat predicate, language-agnostically: the empty id seats the app's own genesis document, an undeclared id is refused as `example.unknown` before anything decodes, and a declared example seats unless its asset is `undecodable` (`example.undecodable`) or decodes into the `genesis` document (`example.empty`). Answered by Rust `example_seat` + `example_decoded` (🛂️manifest/🦀️.rs) and TypeScript `exampleSeatOutcomeV1` (🛂️manifest/🟦️.ts).
